fr: Spectral Wound est un groupe de black metal canadien de Montréal, formé en 2014 et signé chez Profound Lore Records.
Même s'il vient de Montréal, il a peu en commun avec le métal noir québécois, tourné vers l'histoire et le folklore locaux.
Le groupe s'est dit clairement opposé au fascisme et à l'idéologie raciste dans le black metal.
Il a sorti quatre albums : Terra Nullius, Infernal Decadence, A Diabolic Thirst et Songs of Blood and Mire.
en: Spectral Wound is a Canadian black metal band from Montreal, formed in 2014 and signed to Profound Lore Records.
Although based in Montreal, it has little in common with Quebec's black metal, which focuses on local history and folklore.
The band has said it is clearly opposed to fascism and racist ideology in black metal.
It has released four albums: Terra Nullius, Infernal Decadence, A Diabolic Thirst and Songs of Blood and Mire.
